input: Stage the experiment: A scientist wants to transfer 100 µL of a sample from each well of a 96-well source plate to the corresponding well of a 96-well destination plate using a single-channel pipette. The source plate is a Corning 96-well plate (cat# 3603) and the destination plate is the same type. The deck has one single-channel pipette with a 200 µL tip. Write a PyLabRobot protocol that performs this transfer for all 96 wells.
